headline: Russian oil for Hungary. Washington extends exemption
summary: The US Office of Foreign Assets Control extended a sanctions exemption covering imports of Russian energy from Hungarian companies MOL and MVM. The Hungarian foreign ministry announced the extension.
why: MOL is a major Central European oil and gas group, and continued Russian energy supply to Hungary affects regional energy costs.

impacts.name: MOL
impacts.why: The sanctions exemption allows MOL to keep importing Russian energy supplies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
